title: Grateful Dead Live at Berkeley Community Theater on 1972-08-25
lineage: Partial Set 1: SBD> MR> PCM> DAT

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a strong 8/25/72 partial set with stellar Jerry guitar work and tight jams, delivering good audio clarity despite being incomplete.
ai_review.review: The recording, taken from the soundboard, offers clear separation and balanced mix that many reviewers praised as among the best concert sound they’ve heard, though some note it only covers the first set. Musically the show shines with standout performances of Black‑Throated Wind, Loser, Down the Line, He’s Gone, Jack Straw and an exploratory Other One → Comes a Time sequence, and Jerry’s white Strat tone is repeatedly highlighted. The energy is high, but early on‑stage tech hiccups and the missing second set temper enthusiasm.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance and good soundboard quality earn a solid rating, but the partial nature of the recording and mixed comments about overall sound keep the score from higher tiers.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe crisp separation and balanced mix, though some call it only average or decent; the recording is incomplete (first set only).

show_quality.setlist_flow: Partial first set with early on‑stage tech problems that resolve into tight ensemble playing; second set missing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers praise his white Strat tone, poignant guitar on Comes a Time, and overall flawless playing.
